formattedAddress: No. 15號, Lane 9, Daxing St, Datong Village, Beitou District, Taipei City, Taiwan 112

displayName.text: 喵喵有約-北投簡餐咖啡廳

text.text:
We went here for an afternoon tea time and petting cats with our kids. Children under 12 with parent’s supervision are welcome. 🤗

There are 15 cats in this adorable café, and they’re incredibly friendly and curious about every customer. You can tell that each cat is well cared for and obviously in good hands. Their nails are trimmed, so they’re perfectly safe to cuddle even when they’re snuggling right next to us or curled up asleep.

The pancake is delicious and tastes more like a crispy egg cake.

The environment is spacious and cozy. We noticed that it’s also well suited for larger group gatherings, especially for specific activities or event rentals.

text.text:
I was surprised when they suddenly asked me, as if they were certain, "You're from ***, aren't you?" Does that have anything to do with me coming to this cafe? Or, is there a difference in service based on nationality?

You have to order at least a $350 set per person. I ordered the cake set, and I got a tiny half-frozen cake and coffee in a paper cup. This cost is for interacting with cats, not for enjoying food and drinks.

Except for a staff with glasses, the other staffs didn't seem particularly fond of humans. These three stars are for her and the tired cats.

text.text:
This is a place where you can relax and feel healed the moment you step inside.

The space is clean and comfortable, the atmosphere quiet and warm, and the staff friendly and attentive, making you feel completely stress-free.

The most delightful surprise is that every single purebred cat here is beautiful and docile, clean, healthy, and has an excellent temperament. You can feel how carefully they are cared for and truly loved. It's clear the owner has put a lot of thought and effort into these cats, and this love is fully reflected in every detail. She wants to share this love with everyone and hopes you will treat the cats kindly.

This is my second visit, and each time I feel my heart soothed.

If you're looking to relax, find healing, or simply want a comfortable place to relax, I highly recommend bringing friends to experience this gentle and reassuring atmosphere firsthand.

originalText.text:
這是一個讓人一走進來就能慢慢放鬆、被療癒的地方。
空間乾淨舒適，氣氛安靜溫暖，服務人員親切又貼心，讓人完全沒有壓力。

最令人驚喜的是這裡每一隻血統清楚的品種貓咪🐾 都漂亮又溫馴，乾淨、健康、脾氣極好，可以感受到牠們被細心照顧、被真正疼愛。看得出來主人在這些品種貓咪身上花了非常多的心思與用心，而這份愛也完整地呈現在每一個細節裡。她也希望把這份愛分享給大家～也希望你們能善待🐱貓咪們.

我已經是第二次來了，每一次都覺得心被安靜地撫平。
如果你最近需要放鬆、想被療癒，或只是想找一個舒服的地方待著，真的很推薦帶朋友一起來，親自感受這裡溫柔又安心的氛圍。

text.text: Simple and relaxing. The cats are so cute! 🥰🥰🥰 (I was so focused on the cats that I forgot to take a picture of the food 😆 It was delicious 😋✨)
